findCdkInventoryIds.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT i.id FROM inventory_items i JOIN skus s ON s.id = i.sku_id
            WHERE i.secret_fingerprint = #{fingerprint} AND (
              (#{kind} = 'SMS_REDEEM' AND (
                UPPER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.attributes_json, '$.productKind'))) = 'SMS_REDEEM'
                OR (JSON_EXTRACT(s.attributes_json, '$.productKind') IS NULL
                    AND JSON_EXTRACT(s.attributes_json, '$.smsService') IS NOT NULL
                    AND JSON_EXTRACT(s.attributes_json, '$.smsCountry') IS NOT NULL)
                OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sms_redeem_keys k WHERE k.inventory_item_id = i.id)))
              OR (#{kind} = 'CODEX_INVITE_REDEEM' AND (
                UPPER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.attributes_json, '$.productKind'))) = 'CODEX_INVITE_REDEEM'
                OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invitation_redeem_keys k WHERE k.inventory_item_id = i.id)))
            )

listFiltered.sql: SELECT id, code, name, status, CAST(attributes_json AS CHAR) AS attributesJson, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM skus WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (#{search}='' OR name LIKE #{search} OR code LIKE #{search}) AND (UPPER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(attributes_json, '$.productKind'))) = #{kind} OR (#{kind}='SMS_REDEEM' AND JSON_EXTRACT(attributes_json, '$.productKind') IS NULL AND JSON_EXTRACT(attributes_json, '$.smsService') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_EXTRACT(attributes_json, '$.smsCountry') IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

find.sql: SELECT id, code, name, status, CAST(attributes_json AS CHAR) AS attributesJson, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM skus WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

lock.sql: SELECT id, code, name, status, CAST(attributes_json AS CHAR) AS attributesJson, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM skus WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

bump.sql:
INSERT INTO api_rate_limits(key_hash, attempts, resets_at)
            VALUES (#{hash}, 1, DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{windowSeconds} SECOND))
            ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
              attempts = IF(resets_at <= NOW(3), 1, attempts + 1),
              resets_at = IF(resets_at <= NOW(3), DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{windowSeconds} SECOND), resets_at)

attempts.sql: SELECT attempts FROM api_rate_limits WHERE key_hash = #{hash}

bumpAuth.sql:
INSERT INTO auth_rate_limits(key_hash, attempts, resets_at)
            VALUES (#{hash}, 1, DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE))
            ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
              attempts=IF(resets_at<=NOW(3), 1, attempts+1),
              resets_at=IF(resets_at<=NOW(3), DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE), resets_at)

authAttempts.sql: SELECT attempts FROM auth_rate_limits WHERE key_hash=#{hash}

window.sql: SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, NOW(3), resets_at) AS remainingSeconds FROM api_rate_limits WHERE key_hash = #{hash}

listGrants.sql:
SELECT aur.admin_user_id AS user_id, NULL AS user_scope, NULL AS scope_id,
                   rp.scope_type AS permission_scope
            FROM admin_user_roles aur
            JOIN role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id = aur.role_id
            JOIN permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id
            WHERE aur.admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND p.code = #{code}

findRoleCodes.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT r.code FROM admin_user_roles aur
            JOIN roles r ON r.id = aur.role_id WHERE aur.admin_user_id = #{id}

findById.sql:
SELECT id, username, email, password_hash AS passwordHash, display_name AS displayName,
                   status, totp_enabled_at AS totpEnabledAt,
                   totp_secret_encrypted AS totpSecretEncrypted,
                   CAST(totp_backup_codes_hash AS CHAR) AS totpBackupCodesHash,
                   created_at AS createdAt
            FROM admin_users WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

findByIdForUpdate.sql:
SELECT id, username, email, password_hash AS passwordHash, display_name AS displayName,
                   status, totp_enabled_at AS totpEnabledAt,
                   totp_secret_encrypted AS totpSecretEncrypted,
                   CAST(totp_backup_codes_hash AS CHAR) AS totpBackupCodesHash,
                   created_at AS createdAt
            FROM admin_users WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

findByUsernameOrEmailForUpdate.sql:
SELECT id, username, email, password_hash AS passwordHash, display_name AS displayName,
                   status, totp_enabled_at AS totpEnabledAt,
                   totp_secret_encrypted AS totpSecretEncrypted,
                   CAST(totp_backup_codes_hash AS CHAR) AS totpBackupCodesHash,
                   created_at AS createdAt
            FROM admin_users
            WHERE (username = #{identifier} OR email = #{identifier}) AND deleted_at IS NULL
            FOR UPDATE

insertSession.sql:
INSERT INTO admin_sessions(id, admin_user_id, refresh_token_hash, expires_at, ip_address, user_agent)
            VALUES (#{id}, #{adminUserId}, #{refreshHash}, DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 30 DAY), #{ip}, #{agent})

updateLastLoginAt.sql: UPDATE admin_users SET last_login_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}

findAdminUserIdsByRefreshHash.sql:
SELECT admin_user_id FROM admin_sessions
            WHERE refresh_token_hash = #{refreshHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > NOW(3)

findSessionByRefreshHashForUpdate.sql:
SELECT id, admin_user_id AS adminUserId, refresh_token_hash AS refreshTokenHash
            FROM admin_sessions
            WHERE refresh_token_hash = #{refreshHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > NOW(3)
            FOR UPDATE

revokeSession.sql: UPDATE admin_sessions SET revoked_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}

revokeSessionForAdmin.sql:
UPDATE admin_sessions SET revoked_at = NOW(3)
            WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND admin_user_id = #{adminUserId}

revokeAllSessions.sql: UPDATE admin_sessions SET revoked_at = NOW(3) WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId}

revokeActiveSessions.sql:
UPDATE admin_sessions SET revoked_at = NOW(3)
            WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND revoked_at IS NULL

revokeOtherSessions.sql:
UPDATE admin_sessions SET revoked_at = NOW(3)
            WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND id <> #{keepSessionId} AND revoked_at IS NULL

insertTotpLoginChallenge.sql:
INSERT INTO auth_challenges(token_hash, admin_user_id, purpose, expires_at)
            VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{adminUserId}, 'TOTP_LOGIN', DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE))

findTotpLoginChallenges.sql:
SELECT admin_user_id AS adminUserId FROM auth_challenges
            WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND purpose = 'TOTP_LOGIN'
              AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > NOW(3)
              AND admin_user_id IS NOT NULL

consumeTotpLoginChallenge.sql:
UPDATE auth_challenges SET consumed_at = NOW(3)
            WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND purpose = 'TOTP_LOGIN'
              AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > NOW(3)

updateTotpBackupCodes.sql: UPDATE admin_users SET totp_backup_codes_hash = #{hashes}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}

upsertTotpSetupChallenge.sql:
INSERT INTO auth_challenges(token_hash, admin_user_id, purpose, payload_encrypted, expires_at)
            VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{adminUserId}, 'TOTP_SETUP', #{payload}, DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE))
            ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payload_encrypted = VALUES(payload_encrypted),
              expires_at = VALUES(expires_at),
              consumed_at = NULL,
              admin_user_id = VALUES(admin_user_id)

findChallengePayloadForUpdate.sql:
SELECT payload_encrypted AS payloadEncrypted FROM auth_challenges
            WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND expires_at > NOW(3) AND consumed_at IS NULL
            FOR UPDATE

enableTotp.sql:
UPDATE admin_users SET totp_enabled_at = NOW(3), totp_secret_encrypted = #{secret},
            totp_backup_codes_hash = #{hashes}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}

consumeChallengeByHash.sql: UPDATE auth_challenges SET consumed_at = NOW(3) WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash}

disableTotp.sql:
UPDATE admin_users SET totp_enabled_at = NULL, totp_secret_encrypted = NULL,
            totp_backup_codes_hash = NULL, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}

updatePasswordHash.sql: UPDATE admin_users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}

consumeCaptchaChallenge.sql: UPDATE auth_challenges SET consumed_at=NOW(3) WHERE token_hash=#{tokenHash} AND purpose='CAPTCHA_LOGIN' AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at>NOW(3)

deleteExpiredCaptchaChallenges.sql: DELETE FROM auth_challenges WHERE purpose='CAPTCHA_LOGIN' AND expires_at<NOW(3) LIMIT 100

existsAnySuperAdmin.sql:
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_user_roles aur
            JOIN roles r ON r.id=aur.role_id WHERE r.code='SUPER_ADMIN')

findRoleIdByCode.sql: SELECT id FROM roles WHERE code=#{code}

listActiveUserIdsByRole.sql:
SELECT au.id FROM admin_users au
            JOIN admin_user_roles aur ON aur.admin_user_id=au.id
            WHERE aur.role_id=#{roleId} AND au.deleted_at IS NULL
            ORDER BY au.created_at, au.id

insertSuperAdminRole.sql:
INSERT INTO admin_user_roles(id,admin_user_id,role_id)
            SELECT #{id},#{adminUserId},id FROM roles WHERE code='SUPER_ADMIN'

deleteRole.sql: DELETE FROM admin_user_roles WHERE admin_user_id=#{adminUserId} AND role_id=#{roleId}

insertRoleIgnoreDuplicate.sql:
INSERT INTO admin_user_roles(id,admin_user_id,role_id)
            VALUES (#{id},#{adminUserId},#{roleId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `admin_user_id`=`admin_user_id`

updateCredentials.sql:
UPDATE admin_users SET username=#{username},email=#{email},password_hash=#{passwordHash},
            display_name=#{displayName}, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id}

smsRedeemedToday.sql:

cdkGeneratedToday.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invitation_v2_cdk_codes
            WHERE created_at >= #{startEpoch} AND created_at < #{endEpoch}

cdkRedeemedTotal.sql:

            WHERE redeemed_at IS NOT NULL

cdkRedeemedToday.sql:

            WHERE redeemed_at >= #{startEpoch} AND redeemed_at < #{endEpoch}

smsCostByCurrency.sql:
SELECT 'USD' AS currency,
                   CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(activation_cost), 0) * 100) AS SIGNED) AS totalMinor,
                   CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN completed_at >= #{start} AND completed_at < #{end} THEN activation_cost END), 0) * 100) AS SIGNED) AS todayMinor,
                   COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN activation_cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unpricedCount
            FROM sms_sessions
            WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'

codexPhoneCostByCurrency.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(currency, 'USD') AS currency,
                   CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(activation_cost), 0) * 100) AS SIGNED) AS totalMinor,
                   CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= #{startEpoch} AND created_at < #{endEpoch} THEN activation_cost END), 0) * 100) AS SIGNED) AS todayMinor,
                   COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN activation_cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unpricedCount
            FROM invitation_v2_sms_orders
            WHERE status IN ('finish_pending','finish_processing','completed','finish_review')
            GROUP BY COALESCE(currency, 'USD')
            ORDER BY currency

smsUncertainSessions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sms_sessions
            WHERE status IN ('ACQUIRE_UNKNOWN', 'CANCEL_PENDING')

codexSettlementReview.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invitation_v2_sms_orders
            WHERE status = 'finish_review'

find.sql: SELECT ip_hash AS ipHash, ip_address AS ipAddress, failure_count AS failureCount, first_failure_at AS firstFailureAt, last_failure_at AS lastFailureAt, last_identifier AS lastIdentifier, banned_until AS bannedUntil, ban_reason AS banReason FROM admin_ip_bans WHERE ip_hash = #{hash}

bumpFailure.sql:
INSERT INTO admin_ip_bans(ip_hash, ip_address, failure_count, first_failure_at, last_failure_at, last_identifier, updated_at)
            VALUES (#{hash}, #{ip}, 1, NOW(3), NOW(3), #{identifier}, NOW(3))
            ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
              failure_count = IF(last_failure_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{windowSeconds} SECOND), 1, failure_count + 1),
              first_failure_at = IF(last_failure_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{windowSeconds} SECOND), NOW(3), first_failure_at),
              last_failure_at = NOW(3),
              ip_address = #{ip},
              last_identifier = #{identifier},
              banned_until = IF(banned_until <= NOW(3), NULL, banned_until),
              updated_at = NOW(3)

list.sql: SELECT ip_hash AS ipHash, ip_address AS ipAddress, failure_count AS failureCount, last_failure_at AS lastFailureAt, last_identifier AS lastIdentifier, banned_until AS bannedUntil, ban_reason AS banReason FROM admin_ip_bans ORDER BY last_failure_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

deleteExpired.sql:
DELETE FROM admin_ip_bans
            WHERE last_failure_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(3), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
              AND (banned_until IS NULL OR banned_until <= NOW(3))
